home.title: Train and eat to one plan
home.lead: FitWise turns your body metrics and goal into calorie and macro targets, a weekly training plan and a meal plan, then shows how each day went against it.

onboarding.title: Set up your plan
onboarding.lead: Answer a few questions and FitWise calculates your calorie and macro targets and builds a weekly training plan and meal plan. You can change everything later in your profile.

body.title: Your body
body.lead: Used for your energy needs. Estimates only.

sex.hint: Only picks the formula constants. "Prefer not to say" uses midpoint values.

bodyFat.title: Body fat
bodyFat.lead: Optional. With a body-fat value FitWise uses a more precise formula.

method.legend: How do you want to give your body fat?

bodyFat.navyHint: FitWise estimates body fat from these measurements. If the result is implausible it is ignored and your targets are explained without it.

lifestyle.title: Daily activity
lifestyle.lead: Your activity outside training. Training calories are added separately from your plan.
lifestyle.activeDetail: On your feet most of the day

goal.title: Your goal
goal.lead: Sets your calorie adjustment and protein target.
